name: opencode-lib-context
body:
The shared plumbing's opencode 2.x context adaptation: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts` sources the plugin's load location from the plugin context (`ctx.location.directory`, `ctx.location.project`) and keeps the tool's own optional `directory` argument authoritative for the project-root walk-up (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot`) and the stored-identity rebasing (`requirements.requirement.absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary`). The pure `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision` decision resolves a path's boundary and ordered-rule match, pinned by the plugin-free unit test. The scope readers `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.agentFsGlobs` / `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.readAgentEditGlobs` source the acting agent's identity and effective `permissions` rules through the opencode 2.x surface; the way a tool learns that identity under 2.x is the accepted open item of `requirements.constraint.agent-fs-per-path-permission`, and an unresolvable acting agent refuses every path.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.ToolContext`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.readAgentEditGlobs`, `opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`.
